title: redis-pusher FCM message
description: A message published on a channel mapped to 'fcm', or passed to pusher.send('fcm', message). Also checked by redis-pusher, which additionally requires `identifier` for messages published via Redis. redis-pusher ignores unknown fields, but this schema rejects them to catch typos.

identifier.description: Unique identifier. Required for messages published via Redis, where it's the lock key that makes sure only one instance delivers the message.

token.description: The FCM registration token of the recipient, or an array of them.

notification.description: The notification shown by the system.

image.description: URL of an image to show in the notification.

data.description: Custom data for the app. FCM only accepts string values, so other values are sent JSON-encoded.

collapseKey.description: Newer messages replace older ones with the same key (android.collapse_key).

timeToLive.description: Seconds to keep the message if the device is offline, up to 4 weeks (android.ttl).

android.description: Passed through as the FCM v1 `android` field. See https://firebase.google.com/docs/reference/fcm/rest/v1/projects.messages#androidconfig

apns.description: Passed through as the FCM v1 `apns` field, for iOS devices reached through FCM.

webpush.description: Passed through as the FCM v1 `webpush` field.

fcmOptions.description: Passed through as the FCM v1 `fcm_options` field, e.g. { "analytics_label": "..." }.

delayWhileIdle.description: Ignored. FCM no longer supports it.
